ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels. High-intensity pixels are concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes, while the medial region and peduncle interface are predominantly low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches occupy the outer 40% of both lobes. The right lobe (viewer's right) exhibits high-frequency low-intensity mottling within the white patch. A solid low-intensity band extends from the median notch to the proximal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees. The notch depth is approximately 18% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire posterior boundary. Peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 5 to 15 pixels, with the most pronounced irregularities located mid-lobe on both sides.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a sigmoidal curve; concave near the median notch transitioning to a convex arc towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, raised textured pixels (light gray/white) are located on the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear streaks are visible on the high-intensity white patch of the right lobe, including one prominent diagonal mark near the lower-center of the white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe that break the regular serration pattern. Significant calcified bio-fouling clusters are present on both lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct fork-shaped (bifurcated) dark pigment mark is located in the central portion of the white patch on the right lobe.
